detaileddescription.para: While the registry is still registering, the map tracks counts of how many times each constant is referenced. Once the registry optimizes its constant ordering, the map holds the index of each constant (in the local "constant pool", not the real constant pool.)

briefdescription.para: The array of constants in their optimized order.

detaileddescription.para: This is a point-in-time data structure used during reading the AST and during simulation (i.e. when registers ids are being calculated).

briefdescription.para: A Stack of scopes entered but not exited.

detaileddescription.para: Each value in the stack is the number of registers that existed at the time the corresponding scope was entered.
This is called once by each op for each constant that the op refers to.
